notes: Fix from your report: when you ask Saga to log in to a site you are already signed in to (GitHub, Jumia, YOLOTASK, Google or any other), it now sees the signed-in page and tells you "You’re already signed in" instead of asking you to take control. It only hands a sign-in to you when the page really asks for a password or a code that your saved login could not fill.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.11.4: Saga no longer asks you to sign in when you already are.
